source_quote: E-mail: library@rhu.edu.lb
answer: The RHU Library is in Block E; phone 00961 25 603090 ext. 435; e-mail library@rhu.edu.lb; website www.rhu.edu.lb/library.

source_quote: The library was founded in 1999. The building occupies more than 650
answer: The library, founded in 1999, occupies more than 650 square meters with study and computing commons and halls for meetings, seminars, conferences, and classrooms.

source_quote: An integrated library system, WMS (WorldShare Management Services)/ OCLC,
answer: The library uses the WMS (WorldShare Management Services)/OCLC integrated system, accessible on and off campus; it has Internet workstations for catalogs, e-databases and Turnitin, a multimedia room, and Wi-Fi in all library spaces.

source_quote: The library home page provides links to full-text online databases,
answer: Besides print books and periodicals, the library offers electronic and multimedia resources; its home page (https://rhu.edu.lb/Library) links to full-text databases, e-journals, e-books, research databases, online catalogs, policies, and service hours.

source_quote: Classification 21 and MARC21 formats and standards for building bibliographic
answer: Print resources are arranged and cataloged according to Dewey Decimal Classification 21 and MARC21 standards.

source_quote: Faculty, students, and staff with
answer: Faculty, students, and staff with valid ID cards may borrow library materials in accordance with the circulation policy.

source_quote: Prepaid cards may be purchased to use
answer: Copiers and printers are available in the library; prepaid cards can be purchased to use the printing and photocopying machines.

source_quote: Faculty members may request that books and other materials be placed on reserve for
answer: Faculty may place books and materials on reserve for students to use within the library premises for a limited time.

source_quote: The staff also organizes specific training sessions to help users improve their
answer: Library staff answer inquiries in person, by phone, by email, or via web forms, and organize training sessions on searching for and retrieving information.

source_quote: RHU students can borrow, free of charge, books, documents, and articles that are
answer: Through the Interlibrary Loan Consortium, RHU students can borrow free of charge from AUB, BAU, Haigazian, LAU, Middle East University, NDU-Louaize, UN-ESCWA, USEK, USJ, and the University of Balamand.

source_quote: RHU students can visit the Baakline National Library and borrow books, documents, and
answer: RHU students can visit the Baakline National Library and borrow books and articles free of charge under an agreement with RHU.

source_quote: To obtain library clearance, all graduates must submit a soft copy of their senior projects
answer: For library clearance, graduates must submit a soft copy of their senior project in RHU Library format (Turabian) and return all borrowed books and materials.

source_quote: E-mail: helpdesk@rhu.edu.lb
answer: The IT Helpdesk can be reached at 00961 25 603090 ext. 333 or helpdesk@rhu.edu.lb.

source_quote: backbone network is connected to the Internet via a 150 Mbps line to provide bandwidth
answer: The campus network has a Gigabit Ethernet fiber-optic backbone connected to the Internet via a 150 Mbps line, over 840 voice/data points, 40+ wireless access points covering all buildings, and nearly 400 computers.

source_quote: The center includes numerous servers that provide all students, faculty, and staff with
answer: The IT Data Center servers give all students, faculty, and staff storage space and access to network data, software resources, Internet, and e-mail services.

source_quote: (CampusVue), student accounting, finance, payroll, human resources systems, library
answer: The MIS section manages the university ERP, including the Student Information System (CampusVue), student accounting, finance, payroll, HR, library and archiving, and ID card systems.

source_quote: range of online services, including the Student Information System, Moodle, an Online
answer: The RHU website provides online services including the Student Information System, Moodle, an Online Payment System, surveys and voting tools, an alumni section, news and events, career opportunities, and downloadable applications.

source_quote: classrooms and intelligent classrooms. The team manages Moodle – a Learning
answer: RHU uses Moodle as its Learning Management System, managed by the Instructional and Classroom Technologies team, which also maintains multimedia assets in more than 32 classrooms and intelligent classrooms.

source_quote: account management; e-mail services; internet and Wi-Fi services; file-sharing
answer: The IT Helpdesk supports IT peripherals in offices, classrooms and labs, user accounts, e-mail, internet and Wi-Fi, file sharing, surveillance cameras, access control, and ID card printing.

source_quote: E-mail: qaia@rhu.edu.lb
answer: The QAIA Office (established 2014; Associate Director Ms. Mirna Talhouk) is in Block E, ext. 443, qaia@rhu.edu.lb. It handles institutional research, surveys, reporting, assessment, data governance, and accreditation support.
